verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships several background automations that run without manual steps. Patterns runs its Loop agent on a schedule over the trace backlog, online scoring evaluates production traces asynchronously as they are logged, Topics continuously classifies traces, and evals can run automatically in CI/CD on every pull request. These are fixed-purpose features within the observability/eval domain rather than a general automation builder. Missing for 10: user-defined triggers and actions or workflows, alerting/webhook actions, documentation of schedule configuration and controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
